This token grants you the ability to reroll one affix into a fully random other one. Change is guaranteed, e.g. can't reroll into the same affix or one already applied on the item. Rerolling can only increase or decrease the rarity by 1.

This token grants you the ability to extract one affix from an item. This lets you install it into a regular mod slot of any compatible item. Be careful! Once you install it anywhere else, it's locked in place unless you use another extraction token. The affix will can no longer be upgraded after extraction.
Used at the combining bench to move an affix from Item B onto Item A. One token is required for each affix moved.

This token grants you the ability to upgrade one specific affix on an item. Using this on a weapon/tool will increase the kill count required for the next upgrade as if you would've just upgraded normally.

This token grants you the ability to unlock a new affix on a piece of armor or weapon.
Additionally, an upgrade requires 10 appropriate parts if an item's recipe requires them.
Does not work on pieces that already have {ram.maxAffixes} affixes (does not count affixes in normal mod slots). Most of the time it will unlock a common affix, with a very low chance to unlock a mythic instead.
Click on Modify first if button does not show.

You can Ascend a weapon once you reach 5000 kills on it. Each further ascension requires 5000 more kills than the previous one. Ascending resets the kill count and the upgrade requirement.
Ascending upgrades 1 or 2 Mythic affixes (excluding affixes installed in normal mod slots).
Weapons can normally ascend 3 times. Completing the RAM Legendary challenge group unlocks a fourth and final ascension.
Godlike Affixes can't be obtained in any other way.
This blank affix token is required to craft any of the actually useful affix tokens. It does nothing in this form.
A bundle containing 10 random affix Tokens.
Blank affix tokens are the first step towards getting your hands on some actually useful items for RAM. Craft or buy one of them to get started.
Get a kill with an affixed weapon.

Affixes spawn on items found in loot. Loot a weapon with at least 1 affix applied to it and get a kill with it.

Completing this group of challenges will give you the ability to upgrade affixes on weapons all the way to Mythic through the Magic Slayer upgrade system.
Normally you can't upgrade past Epic.
Upgrade any affix through the magic slayer system.

You can upgrade and unlock affixes on weapons by getting enough kills on them. The first upgrade takes {ram.killsToUpgrade} kills before Magic Slayer reductions. See the killcounter/requirement on the bottom right of the screen when holding a weapon.\n\nGet enough kills on any weapon and upgrade any affix.

Reroll tokens are crucial to get rid of unwanted affixes or to try to get that one specific affix you've been dying to get.

In order to do so, obtain a reroll token by crafting, looting, buying or earning them trough quests rewards.

Completing this group of challenges gives you the ability to unlock one additional affix on weapons through the Magic Slayer system.

Normally, you can unlock up to {ram.baseAffixCap} affixes. This challenge group raises that to {ram.challengeAffixCap}, and Magic Slayer rank 5 can raise it to {ram.maxAffixes}.
Now you're starting to get rolling, but you're gonna need to find many more. Get your collection started by finding 10 affixes in total.
Get a kill with any rare or better affix.

Affixes come in 6 different rarities. Ranging from common to mythic. A quality 1 weapon will only ever come with common affixes (If you have enough points in Magic Find there is a small chance to go above this).\n\nSo In order to get better affixes, you're gonna have to find some better gear. Find a Rare or better Affix on any weapon and get a kill with it to get a taste for the good stuff.
Reroll tokens are the most common affix tokens.\nObtain 10 reroll tokens
Unlock any new affix on a weapon.

In addition to upgrading existing affixes, you can also unlock new ones through the upgrade system. When you reach the kill requirement there is a {ram.unlockAffixChance}% chance to unlock a new one instead of upgrading an existing one.\n\nGet enough kills and unlock a new affix.
Get a kill with a weapon with at least 3 affixes on it.
It's time to keep building on the progress. Unlock more affixes or find a better weapon with more affixes applied.\n\nGet a kill with a weapon that has 3 affixes applied to it.
Upgrade any affix to epic rarity.
Through the upgrade system you can only get up to epic rarity until after you complete this challenge group.\n\nUpgrade any affix to epic rarity.

Extraction Tokens are another type of tokens used in RAM. You can use one of these tokens to Extract an affix from any weapon or armor.

This extracted affix can no longer be upgraded or rerolled, but can be inserted into a regular mod slot of any compatible item. Be careful! You will need another extraction token to take it back out if you change your mind.

To get started, get one of these tokens by looting, crafting, purcashing or earning it through high tier quests.
The final affix token is the Upgrade Token. This token can be used to upgrade any affix of your choice. This is the only way to upgrade affixes on armor.\n\nLoot, craft, buy, or earn one of these

It's time to actually start using these tokens. Surely you have that one terrible affix on either your main weapon or one of your armor pieces. Use the reroll token and pray you get a better one this time.\n\nWhen you use a reroll token, there is a 35% chance to decrease the rarity of the affix by 1 and a 25% chance to upgrade the rarity.
Upgrade any affix to mythic rarity.
To unlock the full potential of an affix, get enough kills and upgrades to upgrade to a mythic rarity affix.
Get a kill with a weapon with 6 or more affixes.

Start building a pretty decent weapon by finding something with 6+ affixes or unlocking them through the Magic Slayer upgrade system.\n\nGet a kill with a weapon that has at least 6 affixes applied to it.

Through the Magic Slayer upgrade system, upgrade affixes 15 times on weapons. Unlocking a new one doesn't count for this challenge.\n\nGetting 15 upgrades on a weapon is a very grindy process, it's also generally a good idea to upgrade multiple weapons to get more high level artifacts to extract later on.

Let yourself go and reroll those pesky bad affixes. Remember, a reroll will only ever increase or decrease the rarity of an affix by 1.\n\nCompleting this challenge group will make every item you find in the loot have 1 more affix spawned on it.
Build your own personal collection of affix mods. Use 5 extraction tokens to extract affixes from weapons and armors to insert into other once later on.

Increase the rarity of affixes manually by applying an upgrade token. This is the only way to upgrade armor affixes. However using them on weapons will also increase the kill requirement for the next upgrade.\n\nUse 5 Upgrade tokens.
You probably started to commit to one weapon by now. Get 15 upgrades/unlocks on the SAME weapon.
Get a kill with a weapon with 5 mythic affixes
Now you're starting to get a powerful weapon. Get a kill with a weapon with at least 5 mythical affixes. Affixes in normal mod slots count too.
Upgrade a total of 10 affixes to mythic.
Build a truly powerful collection by upgrading 10 affixes to mythic using the Magic Slayer upgrade system.
Get a kill with a weapon with 11 or more affixes.
Is this your God weapon?\n\nGet a kill with a weapon that has at least 11 total affixes on it, counts ones in the affix and normal mod slots.
Spend a total of 100 affix tokens.

Put your collection to work by spending 100 affix tokens of any kind. Reroll, Extraction, Upgrade, Unlock, Swap and Ascension Tokens all count toward the total.\n\nCompleting this challenge group allows you to ascend any weapon a 4th time.
Wear a full armor set with at least 25 Mythic affixes.
Equip a complete armor set with at least 25 affixes at Mythic rarity. Affixes in both the dedicated affix list and normal mod slots count.
Ascend a weapon and unlock a Godlike affix.

Use an Affix Ascension Token on an eligible weapon to perform its first ascension and transform at least one Mythic affix into a Godlike affix.\nYou need 5000 kills on a weapon to unlock ascension.This will reset the killcount and unlock new levels of power.
Ascend the same weapon three times.
Take one weapon through all three ascensions. Each ascension requires more kills than the previous one and at least one eligible Mythic affix.
Transfer 5 Mythic affixes using the combining bench.
Use Affix Swap Tokens at the combining bench to transfer a total of five Mythic affixes from Item B to Item A.
Unlock a Mythic affix using an Unlock Token.
Affix Unlock Tokens have a very small chance to create a Mythic affix instead of a Common one. Successfully land this rare Mythic roll.
Find an item with {ram.naturalMythicRequirement} naturally attached Mythic affixes.
Find an item in loot with at least {ram.naturalMythicRequirement} naturally attached Mythic affixes.\nRarity increases from magic find do count for this challenge.
You can now upgrade affixes to Mythic rarity
You can now unlock one additional affix on any weapon up to {ram.challengeAffixCap}
Every weapon and armor you find can now come with 1 additional affix up to {ram.maxAffixes}
